predictions.articleTitle: Tondela vs Farense Prediction & Match Analysis: Home Edge Meets Leaky Defense — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Tondela's strong Estádio João Cardoso foundation and Farense's recent defensive instability point to a narrow home win as the leading outcome, with the draw formally covered in an open contest.
possibilityAssessment: Thesis 1: Home Win / Draw — Tondela's 4W-0D-1L home record and Farense's three-match defensive slide support the hosts leading, while Farense's 1.70 goals per game and 1.35 vs 1.40 lambda parity retain the draw (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Thesis 2: Over 2.5 Goals — Combined goal expectancy of 2.75, 55.8% Poisson BTTS probability, and Farense's eight goals conceded in three games favor three or more total goals led by 2:1 (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Thesis 3: 1:1 Draw Contingency — Farense's 75% away half-time draw rate and 64.7% second-half goal share give the visitors a realistic route to share the spoils if they tighten early (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
